subject: Confirming 90m ML/Infra workshop & pre-reads
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Jennings <claire@bluewave.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-07T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow-up + proposed 90m ML/Infra workshop windows

Hi Claire — thanks again for the call this morning. Good alignment on the use case: near-real-time summarization of analytics pipelines + model governance needs. Quick recap and next steps below so we can lock a hands-on session with our ML + infra engineers.

Recap (2 bullets):
- Primary goal: validate latency and cost tradeoffs for production inference across Dedicated vs Private deploys, and confirm data retention/KMS requirements.
- Success metric for the workshop: prototype run showing inference latency within agreed SLO and an initial mutual action plan for rollout.

Proposed format: 60–90 minutes, recorded. We recommend 90 minutes so we have time for a short runbook and handoff.

Available windows (PST):
- Tue Nov 16, 09:30–11:00
- Wed Nov 17, 13:00–14:30
- Thu Nov 18, 16:00–17:30

Ask: please pick a preferred slot and confirm who from BlueWave will attend (engineering + security/ops recommended). We specifically suggest Daniel Park (CTO) and one infra/security owner.

Proposed agenda (short):
1) 10m — goals & context (you + Mina)
2) 30m — ML architecture + model characteristics (Marissa)
3) 25m — runtime/infra + network/security considerations (Ben + Karthik if needed)
4) 20m — live runthrough / findings and next steps

Attachments: RW-2391_TDX_pre-read.pdf (short architecture + data flows), 90m_agenda_v1.docx

If you want a Doodle/poll instead I can send one — otherwise pick a slot and I’ll send a calendar invite and short pre-read.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
[Attachment: RW-2391_TDX_pre-read.pdf (PDF)]

- Can the session include a short overview of how Redwood handles SOC2-type controls and audit logs (we have an internal compliance checklist to validate).
- We’ll need to send a filled security questionnaire — can you confirm a contact to return it to?
